title: Protection: Payments, Sites & Data

freshness.note: options reused from security-ready-2 (split, not new)

pairs.ask: Security Protection: Card payments only through Stripe checkout, do it or not now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Use only Stripe hosted Checkout or Payment Links, with the Stripe portal for billing changes. Card data never touches our pages. Who does it: UpKeep.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Use only Stripe hosted Checkout or</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Payment Links, with the Stripe portal</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">for billing changes. Card data never</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">touches our pages. Who does it:</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">UpKeep.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Collecting card numbers in our own forms would make us responsible for card security rules (PCI).

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Collecting card numbers in our own</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">forms would make us responsible for</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">card security rules (PCI).</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Security Protection: One-page breach plan for Michigan, do it or not now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Legal writes who to call and a notice template. Security writes the steps to revoke keys and lock accounts. Who does it: Legal And Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Legal writes who to call and a notice</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">template. Security writes the steps to</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">revoke keys and lock accounts. Who</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">does it: Legal And Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Michigan law (MCL 445.72) requires notifying affected residents after certain breaches, and there is no plan yet.

pairs.ask: Security Protection: Protection, collect only name, email, address and phone from members: do it or not now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Limit the member form to those four fields, keep photos in private storage, and delete member data when they cancel. Who does it: UpKeep And Legal.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Limit the member form to those four</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">fields, keep photos in private</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">storage, and delete member data when</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">they cancel. Who does it: UpKeep And</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Legal.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Data you don't hold can't be breached. Door codes, ID copies or SSNs in the app would turn a small leak into a serious one.

Why it matters: Data</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">you don't hold can't be breached. Door</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">codes, ID copies or SSNs in the app</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">would turn a small leak into a serious</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">one.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Security Protection: Move the plain-text gate words out of the password index, do it or not now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Move the key into your vault or an environment variable and delete the stale row. Who does it: Grok Bot.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Move the key into your vault or an</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">environment variable and delete the</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">stale row. Who does it: Grok Bot.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: The u-code key in the password index still holds the gate words in plain text, which breaks its own names-only rule. One row about the portfolio password is also out of date.

pairs.ask: Security Protection: One test submit from Niko's finish questions, do it or not now?

pairs.ask: Security Protection: Weekly check that all 45 sites ask for the password, do it or not now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Every Monday Security loads all 45 sites and reports any page that opens without the password form. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Every Monday Security loads all 45</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">sites and reports any page that opens</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">without the password form. Who does</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">it: Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Rebuilds can republish a page unlocked. A weekly check catches anything the push guard misses.

pairs.ask: Security Protection: Hide the build templates from the public site, do it or not now?
